text: And word came to the family of David that Aram had put up its tents in Ephraim. And the king's heart, and the hearts of his people, were moved, like the trees of the wood shaking in the wind.

title: Isaiah 7:3
text: Then the Lord said to Isaiah, Go out now, you and Shear-jashub, your son, and you will come across Ahaz at the end of the stream flowing from the higher pool, in the highway of the washerman's field;

title: Isaiah 7:4
text: And say to him, Take care and be quiet; have no fear, and do not let your heart be feeble, because of these two ends of smoking fire-wood, because of the bitter wrath of Rezin and Aram, and of the son of Remaliah.

title: Isaiah 7:5
text: Because Aram has made evil designs against you, saying,

title: Isaiah 7:6
text: Let us go up against Judah, troubling her, and forcing our way into her, and let us put up a king in her, even the son of Tabeel:

title: Isaiah 7:7
text: This is the word of the Lord God: This design will not come about or be effected.

title: Isaiah 7:8
text: For the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin (and in sixty-five years from now Ephraim will be broken, and will no longer be a people):

title: Isaiah 7:9
text: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If you will not have faith, your kingdom will be broken.

title: Isaiah 7:10
text: ¶And Isaiah said again to Ahaz,

title: Isaiah 7:11
text: Make a request to the Lord your God for a sign, a sign in the deep places of the underworld, or in the high heavens.

title: Isaiah 7:12
text: But Ahaz said, I will not put the Lord to the test by making such a request.

title: Isaiah 7:13
text: And he said, Give ear now, O family of David: is it not enough that you are driving men to disgust? will you do the same to my God?

title: Isaiah 7:14
text: For this cause the Lord himself will give you a sign; a young woman is now with child, and she will give birth to a son, and she will give him the name Immanuel.

title: Isaiah 7:15
text: Butter and honey will be his food, when he is old enough to make a decision between evil and good.

title: Isaiah 7:16
text: For before the child is old enough to make a decision between evil and good, the land whose two kings you are now fearing will have become waste.

title: Isaiah 7:17
text: ¶The Lord is about to send on you, and on your people, and on your father's house, such a time of trouble as there has not been from the days of the separating of Ephraim from Judah; even the coming of the king of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 7:18
text: And it will be in that day that the Lord will make a piping sound for the fly which is in the end of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee which is in the land of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 7:19
text: And they will come, covering all the waste valleys, and the holes of the rocks, and the thorns, and all the watering-places.

title: Isaiah 7:20
text: In that day will the Lord take away the hair of the head and of the feet, as well as the hair of the face, with a blade got for a price from the other side of the River; even with the king of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 7:21
text: And it will be in that day that a man will give food to a young cow and two sheep;

title: Isaiah 7:22
text: And they will give so much milk that he will be able to have butter for his food: for butter and honey will be the food of all who are still living in the land.

title: Isaiah 7:23
text: And it will be in that day that in every place where before there were a thousand vines valued at a thousand shekels of silver, there will be nothing but blackberries and thorns.

title: Isaiah 7:24
text: Men will come there with bows and arrows, because all the land will be full of blackberries and thorns.

title: Isaiah 7:25
text: And they will send out the oxen and the sheep on all the hills which before were worked with the spade, ...fear of blackberries and thorns.

title: Isaiah 8:1
text: ¶And the Lord said to me, Take a great writing-board, and on it put down in common letters, Maher-shalal-hash-baz;

title: Isaiah 8:2
text: And take true witnesses to the writing, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah, the son of Jeberechiah.

title: Isaiah 8:3
text: And I went in to my wife, and she became with child, and gave birth to a son. Then the Lord said to me, Give him the name Maher-shalal-hash-baz,

title: Isaiah 8:4
text: For before the child is able to say, Father, or, Mother, the wealth of Damascus and the goods of Samaria will be taken away by the king of Assyria.

title: Isaiah 8:5
text: And the Lord said again to me,

title: Isaiah 8:6
text: Because this people will have nothing to do with the softly-flowing waters of Shiloah, and have fear of Rezin and Remaliah's son;

title: Isaiah 8:7
text: For this cause the Lord is sending on them the waters of the River, deep and strong, even the king of Assyria and all his glory: and it will come up through all its streams, overflowing all its edges:

title: Isaiah 8:8
text: And it will come on into Judah; rushing on and overflowing, till the waters are up to the neck; ***and his outstretched wings will be covering the land from side to side: for God is with us.

title: Isaiah 8:9
text: ¶Have knowledge, O peoples, and be in fear; give ear, all you far-off parts of the earth:

title: Isaiah 8:10
text: Let your designs be formed, and they will come to nothing; give your orders, and they will not be effected: for God is with us.

title: Isaiah 8:11
text: For the Lord, controlling me with a strong hand, gave me orders not to go in the way of this people, saying,

title: Isaiah 8:12
text: Do not say, It is holy, about everything of which this people says, It is holy; and do not be in fear of what they go in fear of.

title: Isaiah 8:13
text: But let the Lord of armies be holy to you, and go in fear of him, giving honour to him.

title: Isaiah 8:14
text: And he will be for a holy place: but for a stone of falling and a rock of trouble to the two houses of Israel, and to the men of Jerusalem, for a net in which they may be taken.

title: Isaiah 8:15
text: And numbers of them, falling on the stone, will be broken, and will be taken in the net.

title: Isaiah 8:16
text: ¶Let my teaching be kept secret: and my words be given to my disciples only.

title: Isaiah 8:17
text: And I will be waiting for the Lord, whose face is veiled from the house of Jacob, and I will be looking for him.

title: Isaiah 8:18
text: See, I and the children whom the Lord has given me, are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of armies, whose resting-place is in Mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 8:19
text: And when they say to you, Make request for us to those who have control of spirits, and to those wise in secret arts, who make hollow bird-like sounds; is it not right for a people to make request to their gods, to make request for the living to the dead?

title: Isaiah 8:20
text: Then say to them, Put your faith in the teaching and the witness. ...If they do not say such things. ...For him there is no dawn. ...

title: Isaiah 8:21
text: And he will go through the land in bitter trouble and in need of food; and when he is unable to get food, he will become angry, cursing his king and his God, and his eyes will be turned to heaven on high;

title: Isaiah 8:22
text: And he will be looking down on the earth, and there will be trouble and dark clouds, black night where there is no seeing.

title: Isaiah 9:1
text: ¶In earlier times he made the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali of small value, but after that he gave it glory, by the way of the sea, on the other side of Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

title: Isaiah 9:2
text: The people who went in the dark have seen a great light, and for those who were living in the land of the deepest night, the light is shining.

title: Isaiah 9:3
text: You have made them very glad, increasing their joy. They are glad before you as men are glad in the time of getting in the grain, or when they make division of the goods taken in war.

title: Isaiah 9:4
text: For by your hand the yoke on his neck and the rod on his back, even the rod of his cruel master, have been broken, as in the day of Midian.

title: Isaiah 9:5
text: For every boot of the man of war with his sounding step, and the clothing rolled in blood, will be for burning, food for the fire.

title: Isaiah 9:6
text: For to us a child has come, to us a son is given; and the government has been placed in his hands; and he has been named Wise Guide, Strong God, Father for ever, Prince of Peace.

title: Isaiah 9:7
text: Of the increase of his rule and of peace there will be no end, on the seat of David, and in his kingdom; to make it strong, supporting it with wise decision and righteousness, now and for ever. By the fixed purpose of the Lord of armies this will be done.

title: Isaiah 9:8
text: ¶The Lord has sent a word to Jacob, and it has come on Israel;

title: Isaiah 9:9
text: And all the people will have experience of it, even Ephraim and the men of Samaria, who say in the pride of their uplifted hearts,

title: Isaiah 9:10
text: The bricks have come down, but we will put up buildings of cut stone in their place: the sycamores are cut down, but they will be changed to cedars.

title: Isaiah 9:11
text: For this cause the Lord has made strong the haters of Israel, driving them on to make war against him;

title: Isaiah 9:12
text: Aram on the east, and the Philistines on the west, who have come against Israel with open mouths. For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 9:13
text: But the heart of the people was not turned to him who sent punishment on them, and they made no prayer to the Lord of armies.

title: Isaiah 9:14
text: For this cause the Lord took away from Israel head and tail, high and low, in one day.

title: Isaiah 9:15
text: The man who is honoured and responsible is the head, and the prophet who gives false teaching is the tail.

title: Isaiah 9:16
text: For the guides of this people are the cause of their wandering from the right way, and those who are guided by them come to destruction.

title: Isaiah 9:17
text: For this cause the Lord will have no pleasure in their young men, and no pity on their widows and the children without fathers: for they are all haters of God and evil-doers, and foolish words come from every mouth. For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 9:18
text: For evil was burning like a fire; the blackberries and thorns were burned up; the thick woods took fire, rolling up in dark clouds of smoke.

title: Isaiah 9:19
text: The land was dark with the wrath of the Lord of armies: the people were like those who take men's flesh for food.

title: Isaiah 9:20
text: On the right a man was cutting off bits and was still in need; on the left a man took a meal but had not enough; no man had pity on his brother; every man was making a meal of the flesh of his neighbour.

title: Isaiah 9:21
text: Manasseh was making a meal of Ephraim, and Ephraim of Manasseh; and together they were attacking Judah. For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 10:1
text: ¶Cursed are those who make evil decisions, and the writers who make the records of their cruel acts:

title: Isaiah 10:2
text: Who do wrong to the poor in their cause, and take away the right of the crushed among my people, so that they may have the property of widows, and get under their power those who have no father.

title: Isaiah 10:3
text: And what will you do in the day of punishment, and in the destruction which is coming from far? to whom will you go for help, and what will become of your glory?

title: Isaiah 10:4
text: ...For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

title: Isaiah 10:5
text: ¶Ho! Assyrian, the rod of my wrath, the instrument of my punishment!

title: Isaiah 10:6
text: I will send him against a nation of wrongdoers, and against the people of my wrath I will give him orders, to take their wealth in war, crushing them down like the dust in the streets.

title: Isaiah 10:7
text: But this is not what is in his mind, and this is not his design; but his purpose is destruction, and the cutting off of more and more nations.

title: Isaiah 10:8
text: For he says, Are not all my captains kings?

title: Isaiah 10:9
text: Will not the fate of Calno be like that of Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?

title: Isaiah 10:10
text: As my hand has come on the kingdoms of the images, whose pictured images were more in number than those of Jerusalem and Samaria;

title: Isaiah 10:11
text: So, as I have done to Samaria and her images, I will do to Jerusalem and her images.

title: Isaiah 10:12
text: For this cause it will be that, when the purpose of the Lord against Mount Zion and Jerusalem is complete, I will send punishment on the pride of the heart of the king of Assyria, and on the glory of his uplifted eyes.

title: Isaiah 10:13
text: For he has said, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my knowledge, for I am wise: and I have taken away the limits of the peoples' lands, and the stores of their wealth have become mine; and I have made towns low in the dust, sending destruction on those living in them;

title: Isaiah 10:14
text: And I have put my hands on the wealth of the peoples, as on the place where a bird has put her eggs; and as a man may take the eggs from which a bird has gone, so I have taken all the earth for myself: and not a wing was moved, and not a mouth gave out a sound.

title: Isaiah 10:15
text: Will the axe say high-sounding words against him who is using it, or the blade be full of pride against him who is cutting with it? As if a rod had the power of shaking him who is using it, or as if a stick might take up him who is not wood.

title: Isaiah 10:16
text: For this cause the Lord, the Lord of armies, will make his fat become wasted; and in his inner parts a fire will be lighted like a burning flame.

title: Isaiah 10:17
text: And the light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: wasting and burning up his thorns in one day.

title: Isaiah 10:18
text: And he will put an end to the glory of his woods and of his planted fields, soul and body together; and it will be as when a man is wasted by disease.

title: Isaiah 10:19
text: And the rest of the trees of his wood will be small in number, so that a child may put them down in writing.

title: Isaiah 10:20
text: ¶And it will be in that day that the rest of Israel, and those of Jacob who have come safely through these troubles, will no longer go for help to him whose rod was on their back, but their faith will be in the Lord, the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 10:21
text: The rest, even the rest of Jacob, will come back to the Strong God.

title: Isaiah 10:22
text: For though your people, O Israel, are as the sand of the sea, only a small number will come back: for the destruction is fixed, overflowing in righteousness.

title: Isaiah 10:23
text: For the Lord, the Lord of armies, is about to make destruction complete in all the land.

title: Isaiah 10:24
text: ¶For this cause the Lord, the Lord of armies, says, O my people living in Zion, have no fear of the Assyrian, even if his rod comes on your back, and his stick is lifted up as in Egypt.

title: Isaiah 10:25
text: For in a very short time my passion will be over, and my wrath will be turned to their destruction.

title: Isaiah 10:26
text: And the Lord of armies will be shaking a whip against him, as when he overcame Midian at the rock of Oreb: and his rod will be lifted up against them as it was against the Egyptians.

title: Isaiah 10:27
text: And in that day the weight which he put on your back will be taken away, and his yoke broken from off your neck.

title: Isaiah 10:28
text: He has gone up from Pene-Rimmon, he has come to Aiath; he has gone past Migron, at Michmash he puts his forces in order.

title: Isaiah 10:29
text: They have gone across the mountain; Geba will be our resting-place tonight, they say: Ramah is shaking with fear; Gibeah of Saul has gone in flight.

title: Isaiah 10:30
text: Give a loud cry, daughter of Gallim; let Laishah give ear; let Anathoth give answer to her.

title: Isaiah 10:31
text: Madmenah has gone; the men of Gebim are putting their goods in a safe place.

title: Isaiah 10:32
text: This very day he is stopping at Nob; he is shaking his hand against the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 10:33
text: See, the Lord, the Lord of armies, is cutting off his branches with a great noise, and his strong ones are falling and his high ones are coming down.

title: Isaiah 10:34
text: And he is cutting down the thick places of the wood with an axe, and Lebanon with its tall trees is coming down.

title: Isaiah 11:1
text: ¶And there will come a rod out of the broken tree of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will give fruit.

title: Isaiah 11:2
text: And the spirit of the Lord will be resting on him, the spirit of wisdom and good sense, the spirit of wise guiding and strength, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;

title: Isaiah 11:3
text: And he will not be guided in his judging by what he sees, or give decisions by the hearing of his ears:

title: Isaiah 11:4
text: But he will do right in the cause of the poor, and give wise decisions for those in the land who are in need; and the rod of his mouth will come down on the cruel, and with the breath of his lips he will put an end to the evil-doer.

title: Isaiah 11:5
text: And righteousness will be the cord of his robe, and good faith the band round his breast.

title: Isaiah 11:6
text: And the wolf will be living with the lamb, and the leopard will take his rest with the young goat; and the lion will take grass for food like the ox; and the young lion will go with the young ones of the herd; and a little child will be their guide.

title: Isaiah 11:7
text: And the cow and the bear will be friends while their young ones are sleeping together.

title: Isaiah 11:8
text: And the child at the breast will be playing by the hole of the snake, and the older child will put his hand on the bright eye of the poison-snake.

title: Isaiah 11:9
text: There will be no cause of pain or destruction in all my holy mountain: for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the Lord as the sea is covered by the waters.

title: Isaiah 11:10
text: ¶And in that day, the eyes of the nations will be turned to the root of Jesse which will be lifted up as the flag of the peoples; and his resting-place will be glory.

title: Isaiah 11:11
text: And in that day the hand of the Lord will be stretched out the second time to get back the rest of his people, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the sea-lands.

title: Isaiah 11:12
text: And he will put up a flag as a sign to the nations, and he will get together those of Israel who had been sent away, and the wandering ones of Judah, from the four ends of the earth.

title: Isaiah 11:13
text: And the envy of Ephraim will be gone, and those who make trouble for Judah will come to an end: Ephraim will have no more envy of Judah, and there will be an end of Judah's hate for Ephraim.

title: Isaiah 11:14
text: And they will be united in attacking the Philistines on the west, and together they will take the goods of the children of the east: their hand will be on Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon will be under their rule.

title: Isaiah 11:15
text: And the Lord will make the tongue of the Egyptian sea completely dry; and with his burning wind his hand will be stretched out over the River, and it will be parted into seven streams, so that men may go over it with dry feet.

title: Isaiah 11:16
text: And there will be a highway for the rest of his people from Assyria; as there was for Israel in the day when he came up out of the land of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 12:1
text: ¶And in that day you will say I will give praise to you, O Lord; for though you were angry with me, your wrath is turned away, and I am comforted.

title: Isaiah 12:2
text: See, God is my salvation; I will have faith in the Lord, without fear: for the Lord Jah is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.

title: Isaiah 12:3
text: So with joy will you get water out of the springs of salvation.

title: Isaiah 12:4
text: ¶And in that day you will say, Give praise to the Lord, let his name be honoured, give word of his doings among the peoples, say that his name is lifted up.

title: Isaiah 12:5
text: Make a song to the Lord; for he has done noble things: give news of them through all the earth.

title: Isaiah 12:6
text: Let your voice be sounding in a cry of joy, O daughter of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you.

title: Isaiah 13:1
text: ¶The word of the Lord about Babylon which Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saw.

title: Isaiah 13:2
text: Put up a flag on a clear mountain-top, make a loud outcry to them, give directions with the hand, so that they may go into the doors of the great ones.

title: Isaiah 13:3
text: I have given orders to my holy ones, I have sent out my men of war, those of mine who take pride in their power, to give effect to my wrath.

title: Isaiah 13:4
text: The noise of great numbers in the mountains, like the noise of a strong people! The noise of the kingdoms of the nations meeting together! The Lord of armies is numbering his forces for war.

title: Isaiah 13:5
text: They come from a far country, from the farthest part of heaven, even the Lord and the instruments of his wrath, with destruction for all the land.

title: Isaiah 13:6
text: ¶Send out a cry of grief; for the day of the Lord is near; it comes as destruction from the Most High.

title: Isaiah 13:7
text: For this cause all hands will be feeble, and every heart of man be turned to water;

title: Isaiah 13:8
text: Their hearts will be full of fear; pains and sorrows will overcome them; they will be in pain like a woman in childbirth; they will be shocked at one another; their faces will be like flames.

title: Isaiah 13:9
text: See, the day of the Lord is coming, cruel, with wrath and burning passion: to make the land a waste, driving the sinners in it to destruction.

title: Isaiah 13:10
text: For the stars of heaven and its bright armies will not give their light: the sun will be made dark in his journey through the heaven, and the moon will keep back her light.

title: Isaiah 13:11
text: And I will send punishment on the world for its evil, and on the sinners for their wrongdoing; and I will put an end to all pride, and will make low the power of the cruel.

title: Isaiah 13:12
text: I will make men so small in number, that a man will be harder to get than gold, even the best gold of Ophir.

title: Isaiah 13:13
text: For this cause the heavens will be shaking, and the earth will be moved out of its place, in the wrath of the Lord of armies, and in the day of his burning passion.

title: Isaiah 13:14
text: And it will be that, like a roe in flight, and like wandering sheep, they will go every man to his people and to his land.

title: Isaiah 13:15
text: Everyone who is overtaken will have a spear put through him, and everyone who goes in flight will be put to the sword.

title: Isaiah 13:16
text: Their young children will be broken up before their eyes; their goods will be taken away, and their wives made the property of others.

title: Isaiah 13:17
text: See, I am driving the Medes against them, who put no value on silver and have no pleasure in gold.

title: Isaiah 13:18
text: In their hands are bows and spears; they are cruel, violently putting the young men to death, and crushing the young women; they have no pity for children, and no mercy for the fruit of the body.

title: Isaiah 13:19
text: ¶And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beautiful town which is the pride of the Chaldaeans, will be like God's destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.

title: Isaiah 13:20
text: People will never be living in it again, and it will have no more men from generation to generation: the Arab will not put up his tent there; and those who keep sheep will not make it a resting-place for their flocks.

title: Isaiah 13:21
text: But the beasts of the waste land will have their holes there; and the houses will be full of crying jackals, and ostriches will have their place there, and evil spirits will be dancing there.

title: Isaiah 13:22
text: And wolves will be answering one another in their towers, and jackals in their houses of pleasure: her time is near, and her days of power will quickly be ended.

title: Isaiah 14:1
text: ¶For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will again make Israel his special people, and will put them in their land; and the man from a strange country will take his place among them and be joined to the family of Jacob.

title: Isaiah 14:2
text: And the people will take them with them to their place: and the children of Israel will give them a heritage in the Lord's land as men-servants and women-servants, making them prisoners whose prisoners they were; and they will be rulers over their masters.

title: Isaiah 14:3
text: And it will be, in the day when the Lord gives you rest from your sorrow, and from your trouble, and from the hard yoke which they had put on you,

title: Isaiah 14:4
text: ¶That you will take up this bitter song against the king of Babylon, and say, How has the cruel overseer come to an end! He who was lifted up in pride is cut off;

title: Isaiah 14:5
text: The stick of the evil-doers, the rod of the rulers, is broken by the Lord;

title: Isaiah 14:6
text: He whose rod was on the peoples with an unending wrath, ruling the nations in passion, with an uncontrolled rule.

title: Isaiah 14:7
text: All the earth is at rest and is quiet: they are bursting into song.

title: Isaiah 14:8
text: Even the trees of the wood are glad over you, the trees of Lebanon, saying, From the time of your fall no wood-cutter has come up against us with an axe.

title: Isaiah 14:9
text: The underworld is moved at your coming: the shades of the dead are awake before you, even the strong ones of the earth; all the kings of the world have got up from their seats.

title: Isaiah 14:10
text: They all make answer and say to you, Have you become feeble like us? have you been made even as we are?

title: Isaiah 14:11
text: Your pride has gone down into the underworld, and the noise of your instruments of music; the worms are under you, and your body is covered with them.

title: Isaiah 14:12
text: How great is your fall from heaven, O shining one, son of the morning! How are you cut down to the earth, low among the dead bodies!

title: Isaiah 14:13
text: For you said in your heart, I will go up to heaven, I will make my seat higher than the stars of God; I will take my place on the mountain of the meeting-place of the gods, in the inmost parts of the north.

title: Isaiah 14:14
text: I will go higher than the clouds; I will be like the Most High.

title: Isaiah 14:15
text: But you will come down to the underworld, even to its inmost parts.

title: Isaiah 14:16
text: Those who see you will be looking on you with care, they will be in deep thought, saying, Is this the troubler of the earth, the shaker of kingdoms?

title: Isaiah 14:17
text: Who made the world a waste, overturning its towns; who did not let his prisoners loose from the prison-house.

title: Isaiah 14:18
text: All the kings of the earth are at rest in glory, every man in his house,

title: Isaiah 14:19
text: But you, like a birth before its time, are stretched out with no resting-place in the earth; clothed with the bodies of the dead who have been put to the sword, who go down to the lowest parts of the underworld; a dead body, crushed under foot.

title: Isaiah 14:20
text: As for your fathers, you will not be united with them in their resting-place, because you have been the cause of destruction to your land, and of death to your people; the seed of the evil-doer will have no place in the memory of man.

title: Isaiah 14:21
text: Make ready a place of death for his children, because of the evil-doing of their father; so that they may not come up and take the earth for their heritage, covering the face of the world with waste places.

title: Isaiah 14:22
text: For I will come up against them, says the Lord of armies, cutting off from Babylon name and offspring, son and son's son, says the Lord.

title: Isaiah 14:23
text: And I will make you a heritage for the hedgehog, and pools of water: and I will go through it with the brush of destruction, says the Lord of armies.

title: Isaiah 14:24
text: ¶The Lord has taken an oath, saying, My design will certainly come about, and my purpose will be effected:

title: Isaiah 14:25
text: To let the Assyrian be broken in my land, and crushed under foot on my mountains: there will his yoke be taken away from them, and his rule over them come to an end.

title: Isaiah 14:26
text: This is the purpose for all the earth: and this is the hand stretched out over all nations.

title: Isaiah 14:27
text: For it is the purpose of the Lord of armies, and who will make it of no effect? when his hand is stretched out, by whom may it be turned back?

title: Isaiah 14:28
text: In the year of the death of King Ahaz this word came to the prophet:

title: Isaiah 14:29
text: Be not glad, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod which was on you is broken: for out of the snake's root will come a poison-snake, and its fruit will be a winged poison-snake.

title: Isaiah 14:30
text: And the poorest of the land will have food, and those in need will be given a safe resting-place: but your seed will come to an end for need of food, and the rest of you will be put to the sword.

title: Isaiah 14:31
text: Send out a cry, O door! Make sounds of sorrow, O town! All your land has come to nothing, O Philistia; for there comes a smoke out of the north, and everyone keeps his place in the line.

title: Isaiah 14:32
text: What answer, then, will my people give to the representatives of the nation? That the Lord is the builder of Zion, and she will be a safe place for the poor of his people.

title: Isaiah 15:1
text: ¶The word about Moab. For in a night Ar of Moab has become waste, and is seen no longer; for in a night Kir of Moab has become waste, and is seen no longer.

title: Isaiah 15:2
text: The daughter of Dibon has gone up to the high places, weeping: Moab is sounding her cry of sorrow over Nebo, and over Medeba: everywhere the hair of the head and of the face is cut off.

title: Isaiah 15:3
text: In their streets they are covering themselves with haircloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their public places, there is crying and bitter weeping.

title: Isaiah 15:4
text: Heshbon is crying out, and Elealeh; their voice is sounding even to Jahaz: for this cause the heart of Moab is shaking; his soul is shaking with fear.

title: Isaiah 15:5
text: My heart is crying out for Moab; her people go in flight to Zoar, and to Eglath-shelishiyah: for they go up with weeping by the slope of Luhith; on the way to Horonaim they send up a cry of destruction.

title: Isaiah 15:6
text: ¶The waters of Nimrim will become dry: for the grass is burned up, the young grass is coming to an end, every green thing is dead.

title: Isaiah 15:7
text: For this cause they will take away their wealth, and the stores they have got together, over the stream of the water-plants.

title: Isaiah 15:8
text: For the cry has gone round the limits of Moab; as far as to Eglaim and Beer-elim.

title: Isaiah 15:9
text: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood: and I'm sending even more on Moab, a lion on those of Moab who go in flight, and on the rest of the land.

title: Isaiah 16:1
text: ¶And they will send...to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

title: Isaiah 16:2
text: For the daughters of Moab will be like wandering birds, like a place from which the young birds have gone in flight, at the ways across the Arnon.

title: Isaiah 16:3
text: Give wise directions, make a decision; let your shade be as night in full day: keep safe those who are in flight; do not give up the wandering ones.

title: Isaiah 16:4
text: Let those who have been forced out of Moab have a resting-place with you; be a cover to them from him who is making waste their land: till the cruel ones are cut off, and wasting has come to an end, and those who take pleasure in crushing the poor are gone from the land.

title: Isaiah 16:5
text: Then a king's seat will be based on mercy, and one will be seated on it in the tent of David for ever; judging uprightly, and quick to do righteousness.

title: Isaiah 16:6
text: ¶We have had word of the pride of Moab, how great it is; how he is lifted up in pride and passion: his high words about himself are false.

title: Isaiah 16:7
text: For this cause everyone in Moab will give cries of grief for Moab: crushed to the earth, they will be weeping for the men of Kir-hareseth.

title: Isaiah 16:8
text: For the fields of Heshbon are waste, the vine of Sibmah is dead; the lords of nations were overcome by the produce of her vines; her vine-plants went as far as Jazer, and came even to the waste land; her branches were stretched out to the sea.

title: Isaiah 16:9
text: For this cause my sorrow for the vine of Sibmah will be like the weeping for Jazer: my eyes are dropping water on you, O Heshbon and Elealeh! For they are sounding the war-cry over your summer fruits and the getting in of your grain;

title: Isaiah 16:10
text: And all joy is gone; no longer are they glad for the fertile field; and in the vine-gardens there are no songs or sounds of joy: the crushing of grapes has come to an end, and its glad cry has been stopped.

title: Isaiah 16:11
text: For this cause the cords of my heart are sounding for Moab, and I am full of sorrow for Kir-heres.

title: Isaiah 16:12
text: And when Moab goes up to the high place, and makes prayer in the house of his god, it will have no effect.

title: Isaiah 16:13
text: This is the word which the Lord said about Moab in the past.

title: Isaiah 16:14
text: But now the Lord has said, In three years, the years of a servant working for payment, the glory of Moab, all that great people, will be turned to shame, and the rest of Moab will be very small and without honour.

title: Isaiah 17:1
text: ¶The word about Damascus. See, they have made Damascus a town no longer; it has become a waste place.

title: Isaiah 17:2
text: Her towns are unpeopled for ever; there the flocks take their rest in peace, without fear.

title: Isaiah 17:3
text: The strong tower has gone from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus: the rest of Aram will come to destruction, and be made like the glory of the children of Israel, says the Lord of armies.

title: Isaiah 17:4
text: And it will be in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made small, and the strength of his body will become feeble.

title: Isaiah 17:5
text: And it will be like a man cutting the growth of his grain, pulling together the heads of the grain with his arm; even as when they get in the grain in the valley of Rephaim.

title: Isaiah 17:6
text: ¶But it will be like a man shaking an olive-tree, something will still be there, two or three berries on the top of the highest branch, four or five on the outside branches of a fertile tree, says the Lord, the God of Israel.

title: Isaiah 17:7
text: In that day a man's heart will be turned to his Maker, and his eyes to the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 17:8
text: He will not be looking to the altars, the work of his hands, or to the wood pillars or to the sun-images which his fingers have made.

title: Isaiah 17:9
text: ¶In that day your towns will be like the waste places of the Hivites and the Amorites which the children of Israel took for a heritage, and they will come to destruction.

title: Isaiah 17:10
text: For you have not given honour to the God of your salvation, and have not kept in mind the Rock of your strength; for this cause you made a garden of Adonis, and put in it the vine-cuttings of a strange god;

title: Isaiah 17:11
text: In the day of your planting you were watching its growth, and in the morning your seed was flowering: but its fruit is wasted away in the day of grief and bitter sorrow.

title: Isaiah 17:12
text: ¶Ah! the voice of peoples, like the loud sounding of the seas, and the thundering of great nations rushing on like the bursting out of waters!

title: Isaiah 17:13
text: But he will put a stop to them, and make them go in flight far away, driving them like the waste of the grain on the tops of the mountains before the wind, and like the circling dust before the storm.

title: Isaiah 17:14
text: In the evening there is fear, and in the morning they are gone. This is the fate of those who take our goods, and the reward of those who violently take our property for themselves.

title: Isaiah 18:1
text: ¶Ho! land of the sounding of wings, on the other side of the rivers of Ethiopia:

title: Isaiah 18:2
text: Which sends its representatives by the sea, even in ships of papyrus on the waters. Go back quickly, O representatives, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people causing fear through all their history; a strong nation, crushing down its haters, whose land is cut through by rivers.

title: Isaiah 18:3
text: All you peoples of the world, and you who are living on the earth, when a flag is lifted up on the mountains, give attention; and when the horn is sounded, give ear.

title: Isaiah 18:4
text: For this is what the Lord has said to me: I will be quiet, watching from my place; like the clear heat when the sun is shining, like a mist of dew in the heat of summer.

title: Isaiah 18:5
text: For before the time of getting in the grapes, after the opening of the bud, when the flower has become a grape ready for crushing, he will take away the small branches with knives, cutting down and taking away the wide-stretching branches.

title: Isaiah 18:6
text: They will be for the birds of the mountains, and for the beasts of the earth: the birds will come down on them in the summer, and the beasts of the earth in the winter.

title: Isaiah 18:7
text: In that time an offering will be made to the Lord of armies from a people tall and smooth, causing fear through all their history; a strong nation, crushing down its haters, whose land is cut through by rivers, an offering taken to the place of the name of the Lord of armies, even Mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 19:1
text: ¶The word about Egypt. See, the Lord is seated on a quick-moving cloud, and is coming to Egypt: and the false gods of Egypt will be troubled at his coming, and the heart of Egypt will be turned to water.

title: Isaiah 19:2
text: And I will send the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they will be fighting every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; town against town, and kingdom against kingdom.

title: Isaiah 19:3
text: And the spirit of Egypt will be troubled in her, and I will make her decisions without effect: and they will be turning to the false gods, and to those who make hollow sounds, and to those who have control of spirits, and to those who are wise in secret arts.

title: Isaiah 19:4
text: And I will give the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord; and a hard king will be their ruler, says the Lord, the Lord of armies.

title: Isaiah 19:5
text: And the waters of the sea will be cut off, and the river will become dry and waste:

title: Isaiah 19:6
text: And the rivers will have an evil smell; the stream of Egypt will become small and dry: all the water-plants will come to nothing.

title: Isaiah 19:7
text: The grass-lands by the Nile, and everything planted by the Nile, will become dry, or taken away by the wind, and will come to an end.

title: Isaiah 19:8
text: The fishermen will be sad, and all those who put fishing-lines into the Nile will be full of grief, and those whose nets are stretched out on the waters will have sorrow in their hearts.

title: Isaiah 19:9
text: And all the workers in linen thread, and those who make cotton cloth, will be put to shame.

title: Isaiah 19:10
text: And the makers of twisted thread will be crushed, and those who...will be sad in heart.

title: Isaiah 19:11
text: The chiefs of Zoan are completely foolish; the wisest guides of Pharaoh have become like beasts: how do you say to Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the offspring of early kings?

title: Isaiah 19:12
text: Where, then, are your wise men? let them make clear to you, let them give you knowledge of the purpose of the Lord of armies for Egypt.

title: Isaiah 19:13
text: The chiefs of Zoan have become foolish, the chiefs of Noph are tricked, the heads of her tribes are the cause of Egypt's wandering out of the way.

title: Isaiah 19:14
text: The Lord has sent among them a spirit of error: and by them Egypt is turned out of the right way in all her doings, as a man overcome by wine is uncertain in his steps.

title: Isaiah 19:15
text: And in Egypt there will be no work for any man, head or tail, high or low, to do.

title: Isaiah 19:16
text: In that day the Egyptians will be like women: and the land will be shaking with fear because of the waving of the Lord's hand stretched out over it.

title: Isaiah 19:17
text: And the land of Judah will become a cause of great fear to Egypt; whenever its name comes to mind, Egypt will be in fear before the Lord of armies because of his purpose against it.

title: Isaiah 19:18
text: ¶In that day there will be five towns in the land of Egypt using the language of Canaan, and making oaths to the Lord of armies; and one of them will be named, The Town of the Sun.

title: Isaiah 19:19
text: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the Lord at the edge of the land.

title: Isaiah 19:20
text: And it will be a sign and a witness to the Lord of armies in the land of Egypt: when they are crying out to the Lord because of their cruel masters, then he will send them a saviour and a strong one to make them free.

title: Isaiah 19:21
text: And the Lord will give the knowledge of himself to Egypt, and the Egyptians will give honour to the Lord in that day; they will give him worship with offerings and meal offerings, and will take an oath to the Lord and give effect to it.

title: Isaiah 19:22
text: And the Lord will send punishment on Egypt, and will make them well again; and when they come back to the Lord he will give ear to their prayer and take away their disease.

title: Isaiah 19:23
text: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and Assyria will come into Egypt, and Egypt will come into Assyria; and the Egyptians will give worship to the Lord together with the Assyrians.

title: Isaiah 19:24
text: In that day Israel will be the third together with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the earth:

title: Isaiah 19:25
text: Because of the blessing of the Lord of armies which he has given them, saying, A blessing on Egypt my people, and on Assyria the work of my hands, and on Israel my heritage.

title: Isaiah 20:1
text: ¶In the year when the Tartan came to Ashdod, sent by Sargon, king of Assyria, and made war against it and took it;

title: Isaiah 20:2
text: At that time the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saying, Go, and take off your robe, and your shoes from your feet; and he did so, walking unclothed and without shoes on his feet.

title: Isaiah 20:3
text: And the Lord said, As my servant Isaiah has gone unclothed and without shoes for three years as a sign and a wonder to Egypt and Ethiopia,

title: Isaiah 20:4
text: So will the king of Assyria take away the prisoners of Egypt and those forced out of Ethiopia, young and old, unclothed and without shoes, and with backs uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 20:5
text: And they will be full of fear, and will no longer have faith in Ethiopia which was their hope, or in Egypt which was their glory.

title: Isaiah 20:6
text: And those living by the sea will say in that day, See the fate of our hope to whom we went for help and salvation from the king of Assyria: what hope have we then of salvation?

title: Isaiah 21:1
text: ¶The word about the waste land. As storm-winds in the South go rushing through, it comes from the waste land, from the land greatly to be feared.

title: Isaiah 21:2
text: A vision of fear comes before my eyes; the worker of deceit goes on in his false way, and the waster goes on making waste. Up! Elam; to the attack! Media; I have put an end to her sorrow.

title: Isaiah 21:3
text: For this cause I am full of bitter grief; pains like the pains of a woman in childbirth have come on me: I am bent down with sorrow at what comes to my ears; I am shocked by what I see.

title: Isaiah 21:4
text: My mind is wandering, fear has overcome me: the evening of my desire has been turned into shaking for me.

title: Isaiah 21:5
text: They make ready the table, they put down the covers, they take food and drink. Up! you captains; put oil on your breastplates.

title: Isaiah 21:6
text: For so has the Lord said to me, Go, let a watchman be placed; let him give word of what he sees:

title: Isaiah 21:7
text: And when he sees war-carriages, horsemen by twos, war-carriages with asses, war-carriages with camels, let him give special attention.

title: Isaiah 21:8
text: And the watchman gave a loud cry, O my lord, I am on the watchtower all day, and am placed in my watch every night:

title: Isaiah 21:9
text: See, here come war-carriages with men, horsemen by twos: and in answer he said, Babylon is made low, is made low, and all her images are broken on the earth.

title: Isaiah 21:10
text: O my crushed ones, the grain of my floor! I have given you the word which came to me from the Lord of armies, the God of Israel.

title: Isaiah 21:11
text: ¶The word about Edom. A voice comes to me from Seir, Watchman, how far gone is the night? how far gone is the night?

title: Isaiah 21:12
text: The watchman says, The morning has come, but night is still to come: if you have questions to put, put them, and come back again.

title: Isaiah 21:13
text: ¶The word about Arabia. In the thick woods of Arabia will be your night's resting-place, O travelling bands of Dedanites!

title: Isaiah 21:14
text: Give water to him who is in need of water; give bread, O men of the land of Tema, to those in flight.

title: Isaiah 21:15
text: For they are in flight from the sharp sword, and the bent bow, and from the trouble of war.

title: Isaiah 21:16
text: For so has the Lord said to me, In a year, by the years of a servant working for payment, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end:

title: Isaiah 21:17
text: And the rest of the bowmen, the men of war of the children of Kedar, will be small in number: for the Lord, the God of Israel, has said it.

title: Isaiah 22:1
text: ¶The word about the valley of vision. Why have all your people gone up to the house-tops?

title: Isaiah 22:2
text: You, who are full of loud voices, a town of outcries, given up to joy; your dead men have not been put to the sword, or come to their death in war.

title: Isaiah 22:3
text: All your rulers...have gone in flight; all your strong ones have gone far away.

title: Isaiah 22:4
text: For this cause I have said, Let your eyes be turned away from me in my bitter weeping; I will not be comforted for the wasting of the daughter of my people.

title: Isaiah 22:5
text: For it is a day of trouble and of crushing down and of destruction from the Lord, the Lord of armies, in the valley of vision; ...

title: Isaiah 22:6
text: And Elam was armed with arrows, and Aram came on horseback; and the breastplate of Kir was uncovered.

title: Isaiah 22:7
text: And your most fertile valleys were full of war-carriages, and the horsemen took up their positions in front of the town.

title: Isaiah 22:8
text: ¶He took away the cover of Judah; and in that day you were looking with care at the store of arms in the house of the woods.

title: Isaiah 22:9
text: And you saw all the broken places in the wall of the town of David: and you got together the waters of the lower pool.

title: Isaiah 22:10
text: And you had the houses of Jerusalem numbered, pulling down the houses to make the wall stronger.

title: Isaiah 22:11
text: And you made a place between the two walls for storing the waters of the old pool: but you gave no thought to him who had done this, and were not looking to him by whom it had been purposed long before.

title: Isaiah 22:12
text: And in that day the Lord, the Lord of armies, was looking for weeping, and cries of sorrow, cutting off of the hair, and putting on the clothing of grief:

title: Isaiah 22:13
text: But in place of these there was joy and delight, oxen and sheep were being made ready for food, there was feasting and drinking: men said, Now is the time for food and wine, for tomorrow death comes.

title: Isaiah 22:14
text: And the Lord of armies said to me secretly, Truly, this sin will not be taken from you till your death, says the Lord, the Lord of armies.

title: Isaiah 22:15
text: ¶The Lord, the Lord of armies, says, Go to this person in authority, this Shebna, who is over the house; who has made himself a resting-place on high, cutting out a place for himself in the rock, and say,

title: Isaiah 22:16
text: Who are you, and by what right have you made for yourself a resting-place here?

title: Isaiah 22:17
text: See, O strong man, the Lord will send you violently away, gripping you with force,

title: Isaiah 22:18
text: Twisting you round and round like a ball he will send you out into a wide country: there you will come to your end, and there will be the carriages of your pride, O shame of your lord's house!

title: Isaiah 22:19
text: And I will have you forced out of your place of authority, and pulled down from your position.

title: Isaiah 22:20
text: And in that day I will send for my servant, Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah:

title: Isaiah 22:21
text: And I will put your robe on him, and put your band about him, and I will give your authority into his hand: and he will be a father to the men of Jerusalem, and to the family of Judah.

title: Isaiah 22:22
text: And I will give the key of the family of David into his care; and what he keeps open will be shut by no one, and what he keeps shut no one will make open.

title: Isaiah 22:23
text: And I will put him like a nail in a safe place; and he will be for a seat of glory to his father's family.

title: Isaiah 22:24
text: And all the glory of his father's family will be hanging on him, all their offspring, every small vessel, even the cups and the basins.

title: Isaiah 22:25
text: In that day, says the Lord of armies, will the nail fixed in a safe place give way; and it will be cut down, and in its fall the weight hanging on it will be cut off, for the Lord has said it.

title: Isaiah 23:1
text: ¶The word about Tyre. Let a cry of sorrow go up, O ships of Tarshish, because your strong place is made waste; on the way back from the land of Kittim the news is given to them.

title: Isaiah 23:2
text: Send out a cry of grief, you men of the sea-land, traders of Zidon, who go over the sea, whose representatives are on great waters;

title: Isaiah 23:3
text: Who get in the seed of Shihor, whose wealth is the trade of the nations.

title: Isaiah 23:4
text: Be shamed, O Zidon: for the sea, the strong place of the sea has said, I have not been with child, or given birth; I have not taken care of young men, or kept watch over the growth of virgins.

title: Isaiah 23:5
text: When the news comes to Egypt they will be bitterly pained at the fate of Tyre.

title: Isaiah 23:6
text: Go over to Tarshish; give cries of sorrow, O men of the sea-land.

title: Isaiah 23:7
text: Is this the town which was full of joy, whose start goes back to times long past, whose wanderings took her into far-off countries?

title: Isaiah 23:8
text: By whom was this purposed against Tyre, the crowning town, whose traders are chiefs, whose business men are honoured in the land?

title: Isaiah 23:9
text: It was the purpose of the Lord of armies to put pride to shame, to make sport of the glory of those who are honoured in the earth.

title: Isaiah 23:10
text: Let your land be worked with the plough, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer any harbour.

title: Isaiah 23:11
text: His hand is stretched out over the sea, the kingdoms are shaking: the Lord has given orders about Canaan, to make waste its strong places.

title: Isaiah 23:12
text: And he said, There is no more joy for you, O crushed virgin daughter of Zidon: up! go over to Kittim; even there you will have no rest.

title: Isaiah 23:14
text: Let a cry of sorrow go up, O ships of Tarshish: because your strong place is made waste.

title: Isaiah 23:15
text: ¶And it will be in that day that Tyre will go out of mind for seventy years, that is, the days of one king: after the end of seventy years it will be for Tyre as in the song of the loose woman.

title: Isaiah 23:16
text: Take an instrument of music, go about the town, O loose woman who has gone out from the memory of man; make sweet melody with songs, so that you may come back to men's minds.

title: Isaiah 23:17
text: And it will be after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will have mercy on Tyre, and she will go back to her trade, acting as a loose woman with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

title: Isaiah 23:18
text: And her goods and her trade will be holy to the Lord: they will not be kept back or stored up; for her produce will be for those living in the Lord's land, to give them food for their needs, and fair clothing.

title: Isaiah 24:1
text: ¶See, the Lord is making the earth waste and unpeopled, he is turning it upside down, and sending the people in all directions.

title: Isaiah 24:2
text: And it will be the same for the people as for the priest; for the servant as for his master; and for the woman-servant as for her owner; the same for the one offering goods for a price as for him who takes them; the same for him who gives money at interest and for him who takes it; the same for him who lets others have the use of his property as for those who make use of it.

title: Isaiah 24:3
text: The earth will be completely waste and without men; for this is the word of the Lord.

title: Isaiah 24:4
text: The earth is sorrowing and wasting away, the world is full of grief and wasting away, the high ones of the earth come to nothing.

title: Isaiah 24:5
text: The earth has been made unclean by those living in it; because the laws have not been kept by them, the orders have been changed, and the eternal agreement has been broken.

title: Isaiah 24:6
text: For this cause the earth is given up to the curse, and those in it are judged as sinners: for this cause those living on the earth are burned up, and the rest are small in number.

title: Isaiah 24:7
text: The new wine is thin, the vine is feeble, and all the glad-hearted make sounds of grief.

title: Isaiah 24:8
text: The pleasing sound of all instruments of music has come to an end, and the voices of those who are glad.

title: Isaiah 24:9
text: There is no more drinking of wine with a song; strong drink will be bitter to those who take it.

title: Isaiah 24:10
text: The town is waste and broken down: every house is shut up, so that no man may come in.

title: Isaiah 24:11
text: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine; there is an end of all delight, the joy of the land is gone.

title: Isaiah 24:12
text: In the town all is waste, and in the public place is destruction.

title: Isaiah 24:13
text: ¶For it will be in the heart of the earth among the peoples, like the shaking of an olive-tree, as the last of the grapes after the getting-in is done.

title: Isaiah 24:14
text: But those will be making sounds of joy; they will be crying loudly from the sea for the glory of the Lord.

title: Isaiah 24:15
text: Give praise to the Lord in the east, to the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, in the sea-lands.

title: Isaiah 24:16
text: ¶From the farthest part of the earth comes the sound of songs, glory to the upright. But I said, I am wasting away, wasting away, the curse is on me! The false ones go on in their false way, yes, they go on acting falsely.

title: Isaiah 24:17
text: Fear, and death, and the net, are come on you, O people of the earth.

title: Isaiah 24:18
text: And it will be that he who goes in flight from the sound of fear will be overtaken by death; and he who gets free from death will be taken in the net: for the windows on high are open, and the bases of the earth are shaking.

title: Isaiah 24:19
text: The earth is completely broken, it is parted in two, it is violently moved.

title: Isaiah 24:20
text: The earth will be moving uncertainly, like a man overcome by drink; it will be shaking like a tent; and the weight of its sin will be on it, crushing it down so that it will not get up again.

title: Isaiah 24:21
text: And in that day the Lord will send punishment on the army of the high ones on high, and on the kings of the earth on the earth.

title: Isaiah 24:22
text: And they will be got together, like prisoners in the prison-house; and after a long time they will have their punishment.

title: Isaiah 24:23
text: Then the moon will be veiled, and the sun put to shame; for the Lord of armies will be ruling in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before his judges he will let his glory be seen.

title: Isaiah 25:1
text: ¶O Lord, you are my God; I will give praise to you, I will give honour to your name; for you have done great acts of power; your purposes in the past have been made true and certain in effect.

title: Isaiah 25:2
text: For you have made a town a waste place: a strong town a mass of broken walls; the tower of the men of pride has come to an end; it will never be put up again.

title: Isaiah 25:3
text: For this cause will the strong people give glory to you, the town of the cruel ones will be in fear of you.

title: Isaiah 25:4
text: For you have been a strong place for the poor and the crushed in their trouble, a safe place from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the wrath of the cruel ones is like a winter storm.

title: Isaiah 25:5
text: As heat by the shade of a cloud, the noise of the men of pride has been made quiet by you; as heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the cruel ones has been stopped.

title: Isaiah 25:6
text: ¶And in this mountain will the Lord of armies make for all peoples a feast of good things, a feast of wines long stored, of good things sweet to the taste, of wines long kept and tested.

title: Isaiah 25:7
text: And in this mountain he will put an end to the shade covering the face of all peoples, and the veil which is stretched over all nations.

title: Isaiah 25:8
text: He has put an end to death for ever; and the Lord God will take away all weeping; and he will put an end to the shame of his people in all the earth: for the Lord has said it.

title: Isaiah 25:9
text: ¶And in that day it will be said, See, this is our God; we have been waiting for him, and he will be our saviour: this is the Lord in whom is our hope; we will be glad and have delight in his salvation.

title: Isaiah 25:10
text: For in this mountain will the hand of the Lord come to rest, and Moab will be crushed down in his place, even as the dry stems of the grain are crushed under foot in the waste place.

title: Isaiah 25:11
text: And if he puts out his hands, like a man stretching out his hands in swimming, the Lord will make low his pride, however expert his designs.

title: Isaiah 25:12
text: And the strong tower of your walls has been broken by him, made low, and crushed even to the dust.

title: Isaiah 26:1
text: ¶In that day will this song be made in the land of Judah: We have a strong town; he will make salvation our walls and towers.

title: Isaiah 26:2
text: Let the doors be open, so that the upright nation which keeps faith may come in.

title: Isaiah 26:3
text: The man whose heart is unmoved you will keep in peace, because his hope is in you.

title: Isaiah 26:4
text: Let your hope be in the Lord for ever: for the Lord Jah is an unchanging Rock.

title: Isaiah 26:5
text: ¶For he has made low those who are lifted up, all the people of the town of pride: he makes it low, crushing it down to the earth; he makes it low in the dust.

title: Isaiah 26:6
text: It will be crushed under the feet of the poor and the steps of those who are in need.

title: Isaiah 26:7
text: The way of the good man is straight; the road of the upright is made smooth by you.

title: Isaiah 26:8
text: We have been waiting for you, O Lord; the desire of our soul is for the memory of your name.

title: Isaiah 26:9
text: In the night the desire of my soul has been for you; early will my spirit be searching for you; for when your punishments come on the earth, the people of the world will get the knowledge of righteousness.

title: Isaiah 26:10
text: Even if you are kind to the evil-doer, he will not go after righteousness; even in the land of the upright he will still go on in his wrongdoing, and will not see the glory of the Lord.

title: Isaiah 26:11
text: Lord, your hand is lifted up, but they do not see: let them see...yes, your haters will be burned up in the fire.

title: Isaiah 26:12
text: ¶Lord, you will give us peace: for all our works are the outcome of your purpose.

title: Isaiah 26:13
text: O Lord, our God, other lords than you have had rule over us; but in you only is our salvation, and no other name will we take on our lips.

title: Isaiah 26:14
text: The dead will not come back to life: their spirits will not come back to earth; for this cause you have sent destruction on them, so that the memory of them is dead.

title: Isaiah 26:15
text: You have made the nation great, O Lord, you have made it great; glory is yours: you have made wide the limits of the land.

title: Isaiah 26:16
text: Lord, in trouble our eyes have been turned to you, we sent up a prayer when your punishment was on us.

title: Isaiah 26:17
text: As a woman with child, whose time is near, is troubled, crying out in her pain; so have we been before you, O Lord.

title: Isaiah 26:18
text: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have given birth to wind; no salvation has come to the earth through us, and no children have come into the world.

title: Isaiah 26:19
text: Your dead will come back; their dead bodies will come to life again. Those in the dust, awaking from their sleep, will send out a song; for your dew is a dew of light, and the earth will give birth to the shades.

title: Isaiah 26:20
text: ¶Come, my people, into your secret places, and let your doors be shut: keep yourself safe for a short time, till his wrath is over.

title: Isaiah 26:21
text: For the Lord is coming out of his place to send punishment on the people of the earth for their evil-doing: the earth will let the blood drained out on her be seen, and will keep her dead covered no longer.

title: Isaiah 27:1
text: ¶In that day the Lord, with his great and strong and cruel sword, will send punishment on Leviathan, the quick-moving snake, and on Leviathan, the twisted snake; and he will put to death the dragon which is in the sea.

title: Isaiah 27:2
text: In that day it will be said, A vine-garden of delight, make a song about it.

title: Isaiah 27:3
text: I, the Lord, am watching it; I will give it water at all times: I will keep it night and day, for fear that any damage comes to it.

title: Isaiah 27:4
text: My passion is over: if the thorns were fighting against me, I would make an attack on them, and they would be burned up together.

title: Isaiah 27:5
text: Or let him put himself under my power, and make peace with me.

title: Isaiah 27:6
text: In days to come Jacob will take root: Israel will put out buds and flowers; and the face of the world will be full of fruit.

title: Isaiah 27:7
text: ¶Is his punishment like the punishment of those who overcame him? or are his dead as great in number as those he put to the sword?

title: Isaiah 27:8
text: Your anger against her has been made clear by driving her away; he has taken her away with his storm-wind in the day of his east wind.

title: Isaiah 27:9
text: So by this will the sin of Jacob be covered, and this is all the fruit of taking away his punishment; when all the stones of the altar are crushed together, so that the wood pillars and the sun-images will not be put up again.

title: Isaiah 27:10
text: For the strong town is without men, an unpeopled living-place; and she has become a waste land: there the young ox will take his rest, and its branches will be food for him.

title: Isaiah 27:11
text: When its branches are dry they will be broken off; the women will come and put fire to them: for it is a foolish people; for this cause he who made them will have no mercy on them, and he whose work they are will not have pity on them.

title: Isaiah 27:12
text: And it will be in that day that the Lord will get together his grain, from the River to the stream of Egypt, and you will be got together with care, O children of Israel.

title: Isaiah 27:13
text: And it will be in that day that a great horn will be sounded; and those who were wandering in the land of Assyria, and those who had been sent away into the land of Egypt, will come; and they will give worship to the Lord in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

title: Isaiah 28:1
text: ¶Ho! crown of pride of those who are given up to wine in Ephraim, and the dead flower of his glory which is on the head of those who are overcome by strong drink!

title: Isaiah 28:2
text: See, the Lord has a strong and cruel one; like a rain of ice, a storm of destruction, like the overflowing of a strong river, he will violently overcome them.

title: Isaiah 28:3
text: The crown of pride of those who are given up to wine in Ephraim will be crushed under foot;

title: Isaiah 28:4
text: And the dead flower of his glory, which is on the head of the fertile valley, will be like the first early fruit before the summer; which a man takes and puts in his mouth the minute he sees it.

title: Isaiah 28:5
text: In that day will the Lord of armies be a crown of glory, and a fair ornament, to the rest of his people;

title: Isaiah 28:6
text: And a spirit of wisdom to the judge, and strength to those who keep back the attackers at the door of the town.

title: Isaiah 28:7
text: And further, these are uncertain through wine, and have gone out of the right way through strong drink: the priest and the prophet are uncertain through strong drink, they are overcome by wine, they have gone out of the way through strong drink; their vision is false, they go wrong in their decisions.

title: Isaiah 28:8
text: For all the tables are covered with coughed-up food, so that there is not a clean place.

title: Isaiah 28:9
text: ¶To whom will he give knowledge? and to whom will he make clear the word? Will it be to those who have newly given up milk, and who have only now been taken from the breast?

title: Isaiah 28:10
text: For it is one rule after another; one line after another; here a little, there a little.

title: Isaiah 28:11
text: No, but with broken talk, and with a strange tongue, he will give his word to this people:

title: Isaiah 28:12
text: To whom he said, This is the rest, give rest to him who is tired; and by this you may get new strength; but they would not give ear.

title: Isaiah 28:13
text: For this cause the word of the Lord will be to them rule after rule, line after line, here a little, there a little; so that they may go on their way, and falling back may be broken, and taken in the net.

title: Isaiah 28:14
text: ¶Give ear then to the word of the Lord, you men of pride, the rulers of this people in Jerusalem:

title: Isaiah 28:15
text: Because you have said, We have made death our friend, and with the underworld we have made an agreement; when the overflowing waters come through they will not come near us; for we are looking to false words for help, taking cover in what is untrue:

title: Isaiah 28:16
text: For this cause says the Lord God, See, I am placing in Zion as a base, a stone, a tested stone, an angle-stone which is certain and of great value: and he who has faith will not give way.

title: Isaiah 28:17
text: And I will make right decision the measuring-line, and righteousness the weight: and the ice-storm will take away the safe place of false words, and the secret place will be covered by the flowing waters.

title: Isaiah 28:18
text: And the help you were looking for from death will come to nothing, and your agreement with the underworld will be broken; when the overflowing waters come through, then you will be overcome by them.

title: Isaiah 28:19
text: Whenever they come through they will overtake you; for they will come through morning after morning, by day and by night: and the news will be nothing but fear.

title: Isaiah 28:20
text: For the bed is not long enough for a man to be stretched out on: and the cover is not wide enough for him to be covered with.

title: Isaiah 28:21
text: For the Lord will come up as on Mount Perazim, he will be moved to wrath as in the valley of Gibeon; so that he may do his work--strange is his work; and give effect to his act--unnatural is his act.

title: Isaiah 28:22
text: And now, take care that you do not make sport of him, or your bands will be made strong; for I have had word from the Lord, the Lord of armies, of an end, of a complete end, which is to come on all the land.

title: Isaiah 28:23
text: ¶Let your ears be open to my voice; give attention to what I say.

title: Isaiah 28:24
text: Is the ploughman for ever ploughing? does he not get the earth ready and broken up for the seed?

title: Isaiah 28:25
text: When the face of the earth has been levelled, does he not put in the different sorts of seed, and the grain in lines, and the barley in its place, and the spelt at the edge?

title: Isaiah 28:26
text: For his God is his teacher, giving him the knowledge of these things.

title: Isaiah 28:27
text: For the fitches are not crushed with a sharp instrument, and a cart-wheel is not rolled over the cummin; but the grain of the fitches is hammered out with a stick, and of the cummin with a rod.

title: Isaiah 28:28
text: Is the grain for bread crushed? He does not go on crushing it for ever, but he lets his cart-wheels and his horses go over it without crushing it.

title: Isaiah 28:29
text: This comes from the Lord of armies, purposing wonders, and wise in all his acts.

title: Isaiah 29:1
text: ¶Ho! Ariel, Ariel, the town against which David made war; put year to year, let the feasts come round:

title: Isaiah 29:2
text: And I will send trouble on Ariel, and there will be weeping and cries of grief; and she will be to me as Ariel.

title: Isaiah 29:3
text: And I will make war on you like David, and you will be shut in by earthworks, and I will make towers round you.

title: Isaiah 29:4
text: And you will be made low, and your voice will come out of the earth, and your words will be low out of the dust; and your voice will come out of the earth like that of a spirit, making bird-like noises out of the dust.

title: Isaiah 29:5
text: And the army of your attackers will be like small dust, and all the cruel ones like dry stems gone before the wind; suddenly it will come about.

title: Isaiah 29:6
text: The Lord of armies will come in with thunder and earth-shaking and great noise, with rushing wind and storm, and the flame of burning fire.

title: Isaiah 29:7
text: And all the nations making war on Ariel, and all those who are fighting against her and shutting her in with their towers, will be like a dream, like a vision of the night.

title: Isaiah 29:8
text: And it will be like a man desiring food, and dreaming that he is feasting; but when he is awake there is nothing in his mouth: or like a man in need of water, dreaming that he is drinking; but when he is awake he is feeble and his soul is full of desire: so will all the nations be which make war on Mount Zion.

title: Isaiah 29:9
text: ¶Be surprised and full of wonder; let your eyes be covered and be blind: be overcome, but not with wine; go with uncertain steps, but not because of strong drink.

title: Isaiah 29:10
text: For the Lord has sent on you a spirit of deep sleep; and by him your eyes, the prophets, are shut, and your heads, the seers, are covered.

title: Isaiah 29:11
text: And the vision of all this has become to you like the words of a book which is shut, which men give to one who has knowledge of writing, saying, Make clear to us what is in the book: and he says, I am not able to, for the book is shut:

title: Isaiah 29:12
text: And they give it to one without learning, saying, Make clear to us what is in the book: and he says, I have no knowledge of writing.

title: Isaiah 29:13
text: And the Lord said, because this people come near to me with their mouths, and give honour to me with their lips, but their heart is far from me, and their fear of me is false, a rule given them by the teaching of men;

title: Isaiah 29:14
text: For this cause I will again do a strange thing among this people, a thing to be wondered at: and the wisdom of their wise men will come to nothing, and the sense of their guides will no longer be seen.

title: Isaiah 29:15
text: Cursed are those who go deep to keep their designs secret from the Lord, and whose works are in the dark, and who say, Who sees us? and who has knowledge of our acts?

title: Isaiah 29:16
text: You are turning things upside down! Is the wet earth the same to you as the one who is forming it? will the thing made say of him who made it, He made me not: or the thing formed say of him who gave it form, He has no knowledge?

title: Isaiah 29:17
text: ¶In a very short time Lebanon will become a fertile field, and the fertile field will seem like a wood.

title: Isaiah 29:18
text: And in that day those whose ears are stopped will be hearing the words of the book; and the eyes of the blind will see through the mist and the dark.

title: Isaiah 29:19
text: And the poor will have their joy in the Lord increased, and those in need will be glad in the Holy One of Israel.

title: Isaiah 29:20
text: For the cruel one has come to nothing; and those who make sport of the Lord are gone; and those who are watching to do evil are cut off:

title: Isaiah 29:21
text: Who give help to a man in a wrong cause, and who put a net for the feet of him who gives decisions in the public place, taking away a man's right without cause.

title: Isaiah 29:22
text: For this reason the Lord, the saviour of Abraham, says about the family of Jacob, Jacob will not now be put to shame, or his face be clouded with fear.

title: Isaiah 29:23
text: But when they, the children of Jacob, see the work of my hands among them, they will give honour to my name; yes, they will give honour to the Holy One of Jacob, and go in fear of the God of Israel.

title: Isaiah 29:24
text: Those whose hearts were turned away from him will get knowledge, and those who made an outcry against him will give attention to his teaching.

title: Isaiah 30:1
text: ¶Ho! uncontrolled children, says the Lord, who give effect to a purpose which is not mine, and who make an agreement, but not by my spirit, increasing their sin:

title: Isaiah 30:2
text: Who make a move to go down into Egypt, without authority from me; who are looking to the strength of Pharaoh for help, and whose hope is in the shade of Egypt.

title: Isaiah 30:3
text: And the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and your hope in the shade of Egypt will come to nothing.

title: Isaiah 30:4
text: For his chiefs are at Zoan, and his representatives have come to Hanes.

title: Isaiah 30:5
text: For they have all come with offerings to a people of no use to them, in whom is no help or profit, but only shame and a bad name.

title: Isaiah 30:6
text: The word about the Beasts of the South. Through the land of trouble and grief, the land of the she-lion and the voice of the lion, of the snake and the burning winged snake, they take their wealth on the backs of young asses, and their stores on camels, to a people in whom is no profit.

title: Isaiah 30:7
text: For there is no use or purpose in the help of Egypt: so I have said about her, She is Rahab, who has come to an end.

title: Isaiah 30:8
text: ¶Now go, put it in writing before them on a board, and make a record of it in a book, so that it may be for the future, a witness for all time to come.

title: Isaiah 30:9
text: For they are an uncontrolled people, false-hearted, who will not give ear to the teaching of the Lord:

title: Isaiah 30:10
text: Who say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Do not give us word of what is true, but say false things to give us pleasure:

title: Isaiah 30:11
text: Get out of the good way, turning from the right road; do not keep the Holy One of Israel before our minds.

title: Isaiah 30:12
text: For this cause the Holy One of Israel says, Because you will not give ear to this word, and are looking for help in ways of deceit and evil, and are putting your hope in them:

title: Isaiah 30:13
text: This sin will be to you like a crack in a high wall, causing its fall suddenly and in a minute.

title: Isaiah 30:14
text: And he will let it be broken as a potter's vessel is broken: it will be smashed to bits without mercy; so that there will not be a bit in which one may take fire from the fireplace, or water from the spring.

title: Isaiah 30:15
text: For the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, said, In quiet and rest is your salvation: peace and hope are your strength: but you would not have it so.

title: Isaiah 30:16
text: Saying, No, for we will go in flight on horses; so you will certainly go in flight: and, We will go on the backs of quick-running beasts; so those who go after you will be quick-footed.

title: Isaiah 30:17
text: A thousand will go in fear before one; even before five you will go in flight: till you are like a pillar by itself on the top of a mountain, and like a flag on a hill.

title: Isaiah 30:18
text: ¶For this cause the Lord will be waiting, so that he may be kind to you; and he will be lifted up, so that he may have mercy on you; for the Lord is a God of righteousness: there is a blessing on all whose hope is in him.

title: Isaiah 30:19
text: O people, living in Zion, at Jerusalem, your weeping will be ended; he will certainly have mercy on you at the sound of your cry; when it comes to his ear, he will give you an answer.

title: Isaiah 30:20
text: And though the Lord will give you the bread of trouble and the water of grief, you will no longer put your teacher on one side, but you will see your teacher:

title: Isaiah 30:21
text: And at your back, when you are turning to the right hand or to the left, a voice will be sounding in your ears, saying, This is the way in which you are to go.

title: Isaiah 30:22
text: And you will make unclean what is covering your pictured images of silver, and the plating of your images of gold: you will send them away as an unclean thing, saying, Be gone!

title: Isaiah 30:23
text: And he will give rain for your seed, so that you may put it in the earth; and you will have bread from the produce of the earth, good and more than enough for your needs: in that day the cattle will get their food in wide grass-lands.

title: Isaiah 30:24
text: And the oxen and the young asses which are used for ploughing, will have salted grain which has been made free from the waste with fork and basket.

title: Isaiah 30:25
